name: Kikuchi Ryou
source:
Because of his sharp eyes and quietness, bad rumors that isolate him are spread around his school. In fact, he is not good at speaking and has a serious personality.

After school, he works a few part-time jobs and takes care of Midori, his little sister. He does all the housework on behalf of his mother, who rarely returns home.

He's the type to say things before even thinking about them, hence why he comes off as being blunt often. His favorite food is a strawberry doughnut.

[Translated from [url=http://kenkou-land.com/mamiya/#chara]official website[/url]]
